## In Entity Set

---


Checks if the target entity is contained within the actor's [Entity Set](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=power_types/entity_set) (Power Type).

Type ID: `sync:in_entity_set`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:in_entity_set",
    "set": {
        "power": "mymod:minion_set"
    }
}
```
This example checks if the target entity is one of the actor's minions.

title: In Entity Set (Bientity Condition) date: 2024-01-07

In Entity Set

Checks if the target entity is contained within the actor's Entity Set (Power Type).

Type ID: sync:in_entity_set

Fields

Field Type Default Description
set Power Type The Entity Set power to check

Notes

  • Checks if target is in actor's entity set
  • Both entities must be valid and loaded
  • Can be used to filter actions to only affect entities in a set

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:in_entity_set",
    "set": {
        "power": "mymod:minion_set"
    }
}

This example checks if the target entity is one of the actor's minions.
